verdict: IDEX posted record sales of $952M, up 8%, as its health and science unit jumped 14% on AI data-center and semiconductor demand — and profit per share rose 15%.

segments.name: Health & Science Technologies
segments.note: Precision components for medical diagnostics, semiconductors, data-center power and space — the growth engine this quarter, up 14% on AI-driven demand.

segments.name: Fluid & Metering Technologies
segments.note: Pumps and meters that move and measure liquids and gases, from water systems to energy.

segments.name: Fire & Safety / Diversified Products
segments.note: Rescue tools, fire equipment and engineered fasteners. Segment sales were $191.5M; shown here net of $1.2M of sales between IDEX's own segments, which the company eliminates.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the company's 50+ businesses — its main running cost, including $32.6M of acquisition-related amortization.

opex.name: Restructuring & impairments
opex.note: One-off costs of reshaping parts of the business and writing down assets.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $15.4M, partly offset by $0.1M of other income.

takeaways.title: AI demand is lifting HST
takeaways.text: Health & Science Technologies sales jumped 14% (13% organic) on data-center power and semiconductor demand — 46% of IDEX's total sales now come from this segment.

takeaways.title: Orders point to more growth
takeaways.text: Orders rose 13% to $991M — more than the quarter's sales — and IDEX raised full-year guidance again, to organic sales growth of 6.5–6.8%.

takeaways.title: Two profit numbers
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $1.95; the $2.33 'adjusted' figure the company headlines strips out amortization and restructuring. Profit margin widened either way.

oneTimers: Adjusted EPS of $2.33 excludes $3.4M of restructuring charges and asset impairments and $32.6M of intangible-asset amortization; GAAP EPS was $1.95.
footerNote: Net income of $144.0M is before a $0.1M loss allocated to noncontrolling interests; net income attributable to IDEX was $144.1M, which is what the $1.95 EPS is based on.
